arStrings.szText: "What did you want to discuss with me?"
I belong to an order of assassins known as the Viz-Jaq'taar. We eliminate demon-corrupted mages, so we know that Bartuc the Bloody has returned to Sanctuary. He is the cause of these Chaos Rifts.
If you help us stem the tide of these rifts, I'll see that you're rewarded.
